name: Logs
tagline: View detailed event logs for the system
blurb: Logs shows events from the systemd journal, and sorts them into categories, such as hardware and applications.
description:
Logs shows events from the systemd journal, and sorts them into
categories, such as hardware and applications.

Using Logs you can search your logs by typing a search term, and
view detailed information about each event by clicking on it.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
